items.title: Complexity and Arrays
items.description: Learn to reason about algorithm speed with Big-O, then build on arrays with prefix sums and two-pointer techniques.

items.title: Linked Structures and Recursion
items.description: Understand nodes and pointers, and master recursion — the technique behind linked lists, trees, and more.

items.title: Searching and Sorting
items.description: From linear and binary search to selection sort and merge, learn the algorithms that organize and find data.

items.title: Trees and Graphs
items.description: Explore tree terminology, traversals, binary search trees, and graphs with breadth- and depth-first search.

items.title: Algorithmic Problem Solving
items.description: Combine everything in a structured problem-solving method, then apply greedy and dynamic-programming ideas.
